rubrics.justification: Core grading interpretation of 3BA is consistent, with reasonable comments on expanded blastocyst, B-grade ICM, and A-grade TE, but it adds potentially fabricated image-specific details such as asymmetric compression and cytoplasmic granularity that may not be reliably visible.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, BMI, sperm quality, endometrium, and cycle history well, though some links are overstated or speculative.

Overall structure is logical, but several deductions are weakly supported, including strong penalties for stress/alcohol/former smoking and assumptions about stage III-IV endometriosis and low yield significance.

Much of the discussion is broadly IVF-consistent, but recommendations such as ERA after one failure, immunologic workup, routine supplements, and specific luteal add-ons are not strongly guideline-supported for this scenario.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though some suggested interventions are more speculative than standard practice.
